items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is two lines and matches the reference: a short comment, "# Ensure base table is in aliases.", followed by a call to the existing helper. It follows the formatting of the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() inside single_alias. Collector and QuerySet.delete are left alone, nothing is duplicated, and no debug code was left behind.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A minimal fix that uses an idempotent existing helper. It adds no exception handling, no magic constants and no resource handling, and none of these are needed here.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias. The agent's run printed 'DELETE FROM "delete_avatar"' for .all(), and the joined filter still used the IN (SELECT U0."id" ...) subquery. There is no backend-specific branch, and hidden tests passed F2P 1/1 and P2P 52/52.
